Avantic Pharma.note: Founded in 2021, Avantic Pharma continues to operate independently as a pharmaceutical and health supplement company based in Egypt without any record of acquisition.

Bluebonnet Nutrition Corporation.note: Bluebonnet Nutrition Corporation is an active, privately held corporation founded in 1991 and continues to be owned and operated by the Barrows family.

EVA Pharma.note: The company is a private, family-owned business under the EVA Group, led by the Armanious family since its inception, and has never been acquired.

Himalaya Global Holdings Ltd..note: The company remains an independent, privately held enterprise owned by the founding Manal family and has steadfastly rejected all external buyout bids.

Lamberts Healthcare Ltd.note: Originally acquired by Merck KGaA in 2003, the business was later transferred to Procter & Gamble in 2018 as part of P&G's acquisition of Merck's global consumer health division.

Nature's Truth LLC.note: Nature's Truth LLC was internally developed and launched in 2011 by its parent company Piping Rock Health Products LLC, and it remains an active operating entity under original family ownership.

Nutricost.note: Nutricost is a privately held, founder-owned brand operated under eSupplements, LLC and has never been acquired.

Zhou Nutrition LLC.note: Nutraceutical International Corporation acquired substantially all assets of the Zhou Nutrition brand from Branson Books, LLC in 2017.
